title: Mission
description: Durable, versioned goal-level unit above a task. Spec §6.0, §3.1. Normative example: spec §6.0 (PROJECT-CODING-GRADER).

type.description: Workflow template id this mission runs (spec §6.0). Free-form: the workflow registry, not this schema, is authoritative on which ids exist.

parent_mission.description: Parent mission id, or null for a root mission (spec §6.0, §3.1).

inputs.description: Input artifact names available to the mission (spec §6.0).

outputs.description: Required output artifact names the workflow must cover (spec §6.0; checked by the F.0 compiler).

constraints.description: Free-form constraint map, e.g. { language: C++20 } (spec §6.0). Open-ended by design.

budget.description: Mission budget. Child mission budgets draw down the parent's remaining budget (spec §6.0).

human_gates.description: Named human approval gates for this mission (spec §6.0). Creating a child mission is a human gate by default.
